title: Auditing and Generating Synthetic Data with Controllable Trust Trade-offs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating fairness metrics (Equal Opportunity Difference, Average Odds Difference, Equalized Odds Difference) on downstream predictive models trained on synthetic data, comparing classification outcomes for different age groups (e.g., users under 30 vs. older users) using a bank marketing dataset.

Computing differences in true positive and false positive rates (Equal Opportunity Difference, Average Odds Difference, Equalized Odds Difference) across racial and ethnic groups (e.g., White, Black, Asian) for downstream classifiers trained on synthetic recruitment, law school admission, and healthcare (MIMIC-III) datasets.

Measuring demographic fairness metrics (e.g., Equal Opportunity Difference) on downstream classification models trained on synthetic tabular data using gender as a sensitive attribute, particularly evaluated in the Law School Admission Council dataset.
